result.detail: Reset handling: the spec gives no promise that the environment asserts reset at time zero, so rst_n is not assumed. Rules that need a defined last (RR-PICK, RR-BOUND, the range invariant) are gated on f_reset_done, which is set at the first edge with rst_n low. The rules that hold for any last (RR-IDLE, one-hot, RR-ONLY-REQUESTERS, RR-ROTATE, RR-HOLD, RR-YIELD, RR-RESET) are not gated. A pass in prove mode would be unbounded. If the platform reports a bmc-only or inconclusive result, it must be reported with its depth and not called a proof. Suggested mutant checks for review: swap the last==0 priority order, drop the hold branch, and make reset load 0.
